observations.label: connected-announcement-1
observations.text:
You see a marlback cindercaller.

A narrow-capped marlback with scorched mantle edges
and fire-moss tucked into a pouch. It spits a short
gob of fire, then closes with its cudgel while its
breath returns. Its partner answers nearby attacks;
walls interrupt the spit.
Emergency water: carries sunbladder shell; when
burning in combat, spends one water and its turn to
put out the flames. The wet body conducts
electricity. Unspent water can be recovered after
its death; the empty shell remains reusable.
